newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Inner Mongolia iron-tin mine in operation.
newsitem.headline: China's Inner Mongolia iron-tin mine in operation.

text.p: The initial stage of the Huang'gang iron and tin mine in Chifeng city in China's northern Inner Mongolia region has begun operation, the overseas edition of the People's Daily said on Wednesday.
The mine had reserves of 110 million tonnes of iron ore and contained 29 types of metal, including tin, zinc, tungsten and copper, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
It was China's third largest tin mine, the newspaper said.
Officials estimate that China will produce 45,000 tonnes of tin in 1996.
